name: Geneweaver
subtitle: Catch them. Merge them. Weave your own.
localizedDescription:
A creature-catching battler in a sunny world of tomorrow that went sideways. Catch wildlife tangled up with retro tech, battle in blind picks where speed shows you what your rival did NOT choose, and merge creatures into new ones nobody else has.

iPhone beta: portrait, with the pad and buttons below the game screen.

versions.localizedDescription: - Trainers and gym leaders now appear at the start of their battles.
